description: A chunky cartoon rear-loader garbage truck. At the front a flat-fronted cab-over cab, the WIDEST part of the truck, with a large windshield, one side window per door, a dark side mirror on an arm at each door at window height, a simple dark grille and two square pale yellow headlights low on the cab front, and a full-width light grey front bumper. Behind the cab a tall boxy medium-green refuse body with slightly rounded top edges, clearly narrower than the cab: the cab's flanks stand proud of the refuse body on both sides. At the very rear a darker green rear-loader hopper, as narrow as the refuse body: a short darker-green front frame strip, then a tilted tailgate housing, closed on both flanks and on top, with a wide open loading mouth on its back face only, a light grey step below the mouth and a grab bar at each side of the mouth. A low light grey side skirt between the wheels on each flank. One front axle and one rear axle, each wheel a single large tyre (no dual tyres anywhere), dark charcoal tyres and light grey hubs. Cab and refuse body medium green, hopper tailgate darker green, windows pale blue-grey, bumper, skirt, step and hubs light grey, tyres dark charcoal, headlights pale yellow.
proportions: at a cab width of 2.65 m the truck is 7.8 m long from the front bumper face to the tailgate's rear edge: the bumper 0.3 m proud of the cab face, cab face to the refuse body's front face 1.85 m, the refuse body 3.9 m, the hopper 1.75 m (its 0.5 m darker-green front frame strip, then the tailgate). Widths: cab 2.65 m (the widest green), refuse body 2.35 m, tailgate 2.3 m, front bumper 2.8 m, the rear step 1.0 m wide; mirror heads 0.3 m proud of each cab flank at window height. Heights: refuse body top 3.2 m (0.2 m rounded top edges), cab roof 3.0 m, hopper top 3.1 m at its front; the tailgate's top face runs 0.75 m back, then its back face slopes down and back to the rear edge 0.9 m above the ground, then drops vertically to 0.15 m; the cab face from the bumper top (0.9 m) to the roof; front bumper 0.58-0.90 m; side skirt 0.45-0.80 m between the wheels; step 0.2-0.45 m. Wheels: ONE tyre per side on each axle, 1.2 m in diameter and 0.4 m wide, hubs 0.6 m; the front axle 1.1 m behind the cab face, the rear axle 2.5 m ahead of the tailgate's rear edge, the wheelbase 3.9 m (0.5 of the length). (length : cab width : height = 2.94 : 1 : 1.21.)
sides: the garbage truck is symmetric left to right: the same door window, mirror and side skirt on both flanks, the cab's flanks proud of the refuse body by the same 0.15 m on both sides, the loading mouth, the step and the two grab bars centred on the back face.
